question: How much lighter is the multilayer urea crystal with both layers at 400 °C than the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C?
rendered:
The single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C has a mass of 1.118 g (Table 3). The mass for the multilayer urea crystallization with both layers at 400 °C is 0.822 g (Table 4). 

To find the difference in mass, subtract the mass of the multilayer sample from the mass of the single-layer standard group 2 sample: 

1.118 g - 0.822 g = 0.296 g 

So, the multilayer urea crystal with both layers at 400 °C is 0.296 g lighter than the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C.
